patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are frequently used, pairing oversized display text on one side with smaller supporting details or navigation elements on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
Prominent use of oversized, elegant display fonts for hero statements and project titles, creating a sophisticated and artistic feel that dominates the visual hierarchy.
A dominant dark background with high-contrast white text is consistently used, punctuated by sparse, vibrant cyan and red accent colors for highlights and interactive elements.
The hero background image/video parallaxes subtly against static foreground text as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth. The main navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Project showcase sections feature large, distinct project titles presented in a vertical list, with minimal supporting text, emphasizing the visual impact and prestige of each work.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or canvas background that exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving independently of the overlaying text as the user scrolls, enhancing depth. The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport. Content sections below the hero appear to reveal or animate into view as they enter the scrollable area, possibly using a staggered fade or slide effect, leveraging webgl-three or canvas for dynamic background elements and transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic contrast between oversized, elegant display headings (~4-5x body) and smaller, refined body text, creating a strong editorial and artistic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content blocks and lists, maintaining a premium feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, elegant, and unique display typography for both the hero statement and project titles, combined with a subtle yet immersive parallaxing video/canvas background, creates a highly sophisticated and almost editorial feel that elevates it beyond a typical agency portfolio. The dark theme with sparse, vibrant accents further enhances this premium aesthetic.
